proposal.description: Green's fault summary reads the registered over-temperature and undervoltage indicators instead of the live OTP/UVLO conditions, so it uses values one clock old
proposal.reason: When otp_state or uvlo_state rises while the converter is running, Green_LED stays lit one clock longer than it should. When the condition clears, Green_LED comes back one clock late.

proposal.description: Strike blink starts only from the second outstanding strike, as if strike_level counted from one hiccup before the first
proposal.reason: With strike_level == 1 (after the first hiccup, through the retry and the clean-run window) and no latch, Red_LED1 stays dark instead of blinking.

proposal.description: Strike blink is also shown during every soft-start, treating a normal start-up like recovery from a fault
proposal.reason: On a clean power-up with strike_level == 0 and ss_active high, Red_LED1 blinks for the whole soft-start when it should stay dark.

proposal.description: Over-temperature indicator is also lit by the SCR latch readback, as if every latched trip were thermal
proposal.reason: After a non-thermal trip (latch_state high, otp_state low), Red_LED2 lights and reports an over-temperature that is not there.

proposal.description: Undervoltage indicator is suppressed while the latch is set, as if the latched-trip display outranked it the way it outranks the strike blink
proposal.reason: With uvlo_state live while latch_state or latch_assert is high, Red_LED3 stays dark, though the header says each red indicator must show its own condition.
